message: W30's completed read-only audit is checkpoint 21458. Critical corrections before wiring automatic recovery: (1) narrow allowlist to TaskWrite CreateTask/ReviseTaskSpec/CloseTask/ReopenTask/CancelOpenTask and ReviewWrite PutDocument/Claim/Decide/Release/Withdraw; keep Submit and Update escalated because ReviewWorkflow resolves source HEAD and target merge-base dynamically after the saved command/hash is formed. W11 has explicit source HeadOid but target main remains dynamic. (2) Deduplicate the two uncommitted AutomaticRecoveryDisposition/recoverAutomatically blocks in OrchestrationApi.fs. (3) recovery-state read/write locks are per-call, not atomic across read-modify-write; add per-intent claim/CAS/lease so concurrent supervisors cannot bypass backoff/max-attempt accounting. (4) Add concurrent same-UUID retries, late original arrival, process restart after publish-before-ack, and dynamic-head drift tests. Core ledger same UUID+RequestHash is at-most-once via per-root mutex, non-force CAS and atomic receipt+domain commit, but NotFoundAtVerifiedHead alone does not rule out delayed push. W11 intent remains untouched. Coordinate with W30 checkpoint; do not broaden allowlist.
